penalties.text: Compliance, risk, prohibited-strategy and platform updates may apply immediately to existing accounts.
13.4: Master Account rules are communicated by separate agreement and/or e-mail, not published in the terms.

FTMO reserves the right to determine 'at our own discretion' whether trades fall within a Forbidden Trading Practice; acting reasonably, it may cancel trades and cancel all FTMO Accounts or rewards, without prior notice (endeavours to notify) and without compensation; may also impose temporary or permanent consistency measures.
Acting 'in a manner that may damage our reputation, including after termination' leads to termination of agreements and loss of access.

'Performance Reward' is defined as any amount the Provider may make available 'à sa seule discrétion' and is 'not ... an acquired right'; at any time before actual payment the Provider may review, adjust, withhold, refuse or cancel Performance Rewards, including for 'technical or operational inconsistencies'. Funded access is revocable at the Provider's discretion and creates no acquired right or guarantee of future payments.

Quick Strike (trades closed within 30 s): at 30% or more of trades after a warning at 20%, 100% of their profit is deducted from the Performance Reward and the account is terminated if still at or above 30% at cycle end. News window (+/-5 min, high-impact): only 40% of profit from profitable trades counts.

Non-disparagement clause covering defamation, 'discrédit, dénigrement, attaque réputationnelle ou propagande négative' on social media, forums, review platforms, support tickets and e-mails, including saying 'does not pay' without verifiable factual basis; breach allows withholding, refusing or cancelling Performance Rewards.

The Reserve Bank of India added "FundedNext | https://fundednext.com" to its Alert List of unauthorised forex trading platforms in a press release dated 2024-10-22 (Press Release 2024-2025/1351, https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=58949). The RBI says the list is not exhaustive.
Highest day may not exceed 20 % of total profit before a reward request.
Payout not due if trading is judged "inconsistent with the intended commercial purpose of the Programme" (acting reasonably and in good faith). Terms hosted on rzrfunded.com.

Open-ended prohibition ('any other conduct which, in the reasonable opinion of the Company, may harm the integrity') with sole-discretion measures; pending payouts can be put on Hold for suspected breach or reputational risk. Mitigated: written appeal within 7 days with decision in 14 days, 30-business-day investigation target and a 90-day backstop opening the dispute procedure.

Qualitative prohibited practices (e.g. strategy that 'does not reflect genuine trading skill') can forfeit pending rewards, but only acting reasonably, in good faith and proportionately, after notice and at least 14 days to make representations, with a review route.
Rewards are governed by a separate Funded Trader Agreement with the BVI entity, provided only at transition to the funded phase.

Prohibited practices are 'determined in Lucid's sole discretion'; on a prohibited use Lucid may remove trades, adjust balances, pause, hold or deny payouts or terminate, without compensation or refund; the clause continues with a route to contest an enforcement action ('If you believe an enforcement action ...', text truncated by OCR).
Terms of Use may be revised 'from time to time in our sole discretion'; Website, Software, Services and fees may be modified, suspended or discontinued; prices may change without notice.

User Agreement can change 'from time to time without notice'; continued use binds users regardless of when they registered.
Payout and PRO rules are set out in a PRO contract sent after the Test is passed; the contract itself is not published.
Older FAQ says weekly PRO+ activity, current help says one traded day per calendar month (cohort to reconcile).

penalties.text: 14.2.5: breach of the non-disparagement obligation (clause 16) is a ground for termination; clause 16 survives termination.

Prohibited list ends with 'other conduct which in the sole discretion of the Company, represents uncommercial activity, is intended to game the market, or otherwise is not a viable trading strategy'; also 'intentionally or unintentionally' exploiting system errors.
Terms may be modified 'in Our sole discretion', binding 'effective immediately upon posting'; Trading Rules and Prohibited Conduct 'subject to change at any time ... with or without notice'.

Termination for cause includes making 'any defamatory, disparaging, or harmful statements about the Company, its employees, or the Services on any public platform', including review sites, and publishing support tickets or private correspondence; consequence: termination without refund and 'any accrued profits or Reward Balance shall be immediately forfeited'.

A video interview requested during verification must be scheduled and completed within five business days, otherwise pending payouts are denied, all accounts cancelled and the collaboration terminated.

Prohibited conduct includes conduct that 'in the sole discretion of Topstep, represents uncommercial activity, is intended to game the market, is not a viable trading strategy, or is not responsible trading'; consequence can be forfeiture of withdrawals from every other account.
Trading Rules 'remain subject to change at any time and from time to time, with or without notice'; terms changes effective upon notice in a form at Topstep's discretion.
